$comment: Issue #693: declarative schedule manifest. Source of truth for vercel.json crons (npm run schedules:generate). Every route under app/api/internal or app/api/outbox must appear here, either scheduled or manualOnly. CI runs npm run schedules:check.

jobs.name: payout-indexer
jobs.idempotency: Batches keyed by checkpoint event ID; lease-guarded (job_leases).

jobs.name: purge-expired-limits
jobs.idempotency: Deletes only already-expired rows; safe to re-run.

jobs.name: outbox-dispatch
jobs.idempotency: Outbox rows claimed with SKIP LOCKED; deliveries keyed by event ID.

jobs.name: readiness
jobs.reason: Probe endpoint polled by the platform health checker, not a scheduled job.
